LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.title: Zoe
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.IRONCLAD.0-0.anc: Imagine seeing [sine]you[/sine] again after so long.
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.IRONCLAD.0-1.cha:
[jitter][b]SACRED DEMON![/b][/jitter]
What have you done to me!?
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.IRONCLAD.1-0r.an:
Do the lost tribes weigh on you...?
[i][font_size=22]LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE howls with laughter.[/font_size][/i]
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.IRONCLAD.2-0.anc: My puppet of puppets... why haven’t you killed the Architect yet?
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.IRONCLAD.2-1.cha: After I kill the Architect, I will kill [jitter][b]YOU![/b][/jitter]
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.IRONCLAD.2-2.anc:
[i][font_size=22][sine]Yawn[/sine][/font_size][/i]
I look forward to watching you fail.
We both seek [sine]vengeance[/sine]. It will have a cost to pay.
I accept any cost. Every cost for his death.
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.NECROBINDER.1-0r: I know where you got that [sine]Hand[/sine].
The Architect has gravely wounded us both.
Get on with it, demon. Show me your contracts.
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.REGENT.0-0.ancie: A being from the stars? Within these accursed walls?
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.REGENT.0-2.ancie: Yes, I think we can help each other.
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.REGENT.1-0r.anci: More of my power can be yours for a small price.
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.REGENT.2-0.char: I don’t think these deals are good. I’m not feeling great.
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.REGENT.2-1.ancie:
You read the contracts thoroughly have you not?
You have signed them with full intent and responsibility no?
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.REGENT.2-2.ancie:
Are you not going to fulfill your end of the bargain?
How about another contract? Isn’t that better?
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.SILENT.1-0r.anci: [i][font_size=22]LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE displays his various contracts to the Silent[/font_size][/i]
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.SILENT.2-0.ancie: The Architect is not enough, kill your sisters too!
LEAGUEANCIENTS-ZOE.talk.SILENT.2-2.ancie: No need for words, we are the same.
